risks.title: Tariffs and Trade Disruptions
risks.summary: U.S. tariffs of 10% and retaliatory trade measures threaten WAT's cost structure and supply chain. The recent Supreme Court decision invalidating certain tariffs creates significant uncertainty regarding refunds and future trade policy.
risks.score_rationale: Risk positioned mid-report with strong language ('could have a significant impact', 'material effect'). New context in 2025-2026 with Supreme Court invalidating tariffs, creating uncertainty. Geopolitical category carries high weight for a multinational manufacturer with operations in US/Ireland/UK/Singapore.

risks.title: Geographic Exposure Concentrated in China
risks.summary: WAT faces significant exposure to China, with sales declining 10% in 2024 due to government regulations and macroeconomic conditions. Instruments in China dropped 15%, reflecting weakened demand.
risks.score_rationale: Risk identified mid-report with concrete data (10% sales decline in China 2024, 15% drop in instruments). Moderate language but quantified impact. Stable trend but context of explicit regulatory uncertainty in China.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and Management of Sensitive Data
risks.summary: WAT maintains a cybersecurity framework overseen by the Board with annual reporting to the Audit Committee. The CIO ensures prevention, detection, and response to incidents. Periodic third-party assessments are conducted to validate the program.
risks.score_rationale: Risk positioned early in the report (Item 1A) with structured language and detailed governance. Cybersecurity category carries high weight. Stable trend with established management framework and experienced CIO (25 years). No major incident reported but continuous monitoring acknowledged.

risks.title: Litigation and Commercial Claims
risks.summary: WAT is involved in various routine litigation and claims. Management believes outcomes, individually or collectively, will not be material to the financial position, but acknowledges inherent uncertainties.
risks.score_rationale: Risk positioned mid-report (Item 3) with mitigating language ('believes any outcome will not be material'). Recognition of uncertainty but current assessment of immateriality. Stable trend, ordinary course of business risk.

risks.title: Government Policy Changes and Public Contracts
risks.summary: The new U.S. administration has eliminated, reduced, and defunded certain government agencies, canceled or delayed research contracts and grants. These policy changes affect WAT's government and academic customers.
risks.score_rationale: Risk identified at the end of the MD&A section with specific language on agency elimination, funding reductions, and contract cancellations. New 2026 context with new administration. Significant macro weight for a company serving government and academic clients.

risks.title: Rising Personnel Costs and Acquisition Integration
risks.summary: Selling and administrative expenses increased by 20% in 2025 due to merit-based salary increases and transaction/integration costs related to the BDS acquisition. These expenses reduce operating margin.
risks.score_rationale: Risk identified at the end of the report with quantified data (merit increases, 82 million in transaction/integration costs). Factual language without dramatic intensity. Stable trend but rising expenses in 2025.
